claims: The 2026 Men's Final Four games will air on TBS and truTV.
The 2026 Men's Final Four games are scheduled for Saturday, April 4, 2026.
The 2026 Men's Final Four games have tipoffs at 6:09 p.m. ET and 8:54 p.m. ET.
Streaming options for the 2026 Men's Final Four games include Max (formerly HBO Max), Sling TV, DirecTV Stream, Hulu + Live TV, and the March Madness Live app.
TBS and truTV are the main broadcasters for the semifinals and the National Championship.
Sling TV offers a "Sling Orange" package or specialized "Day Pass" ($4.99) for tournament coverage.
Max (formerly HBO Max) streams TBS, TNT, and truTV games.
Hulu + Live TV includes live access to all networks covering the Final Four.
DirecTV Stream covers Turner Sports networks (TBS/TNT/truTV).
The March Madness Live app allows viewing with a TV provider login.
UConn vs. Illinois is scheduled for 6:09 p.m. ET on April 4, 2026.
Michigan vs. Arizona is scheduled for 8:54 p.m. ET on April 4, 2026.
Women's Final Four games are accessible via ESPN/ESPN+.
